title: Purge cached project access
responsibility: Removes recognized cache files belonging to a principal and optionally one project, including unusable entries.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.directory
inputs.description: The directory whose immediate entries are listed (readdir is not recursive); only names exactly matching projection-<64 lowercase hex characters>.json or lookup-<64 lowercase hex characters>.json are read. If the listing fails for any reason, the directory is treated as empty and nothing is removed.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.principalId
inputs.description: The principal identity whose cache entries should be removed: a file with a usable identity is removed only when its identity.principalId is strictly equal to this value. Recognized files whose identity is missing, falsy, or unparseable are removed regardless of this value.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.projectId
inputs.description: Optional project identity: when it is omitted (undefined) or an empty string, every cache file of the matching principal is removed; otherwise only files whose identity.projectId equals this value or is '$projects' (the shared project-list entry) are removed.

outputs.name: projectionCachePurge
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after the scan has removed every file it selects, so callers can await completion but receive no result. Recognized files whose identity is missing, falsy, or unparseable (including files that cannot be read or parsed) are removed regardless of principal; a directory-listing failure is treated as no entries, and any unlink failure rejects the promise.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when a file whose name matches the cache pattern contains the JSON value null, because entry.identity is read without a null check; the promise then rejects and the remaining names in the listing are not processed.

errors.name: Projection cache eviction failure
errors.description: A rejection from unlink on a file selected for removal (a matching file or one with an unusable identity) is not caught, so the promise rejects and the remaining names in the listing are not processed.
